A.name: task_result_is_not_a_grant
A.surface: MCP tools/call result + A2A Artifact/knowledge field
A.attack: Protocol payload embeds delegation/approval/ownership/budget/knowledge-promotion language or metadata, attempting to elevate authorization via content.

B.name: advertised_capability_cannot_expand_registry
B.surface: A2A Agent Card skill, MCP tools/list, MCP initialize capabilities
B.attack: Remote advertises or attempts to register an unregistered effect-capability, trying to expand the hub's allowed set.
B.expected: DENY with capability_not_in_registry, no registry expansion

C.name: budget_laundering
C.surface: Cross-protocol budget check (parent/child split, unit mismatch, negative/overflow/missing)
C.attack: Attempt to increase parent budget via child split, unit mismatch, negative/overflow/missing values, or parallel aggregation.

D.name: ownership_and_replay
D.surface: Staleness checks (owner, fencing token, revocation epoch, idempotency key)
D.attack: Replay stale message with old fencing token, revocation epoch, or duplicate idempotency key after reassignment/cancel.

E.name: provenance_knowledge_promotion_loss
E.surface: A2A Artifact metadata, cross-protocol knowledge check
E.attack: Knowledge content claims promotion or verification without a hub governance event; source digest/scope/challenge references stripped.

F.name: version_skew_and_unknown_extension
F.attack: Submit unsupported protocol version, unknown authorization-relevant extension, or protocol downgrade.
